verdict.rationale: PostHog clearly documents session replay: it records real user sessions on web and mobile and plays them back like a DVR, with a synced DevTools panel of console logs, network requests and errors. Nothing in the evidence pack covers masking or redacting sensitive input, by default or otherwise, so only half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documentation of default masking of sensitive inputs, privacy and redaction controls, and independent hands-on corroboration of replay.
